description: PR 'standardizes names' (PLAT-212): changes local.db_identifier so the payments RDS instance is renamed in place, plus noise: two new default tags, four new SSM settings, and a parameter group description tweak (which the provider treats as ForceNew).

material.why: identifier payments-prod -> prod-euw1-payments-pg is an in-place rename (ModifyDBInstance NewDBInstanceIdentifier), not a replacement: the endpoint hostname changes, so every client connection string (and the /payments/prod/db/host SSM value, which the plan does not show changing) breaks, and AWS documents downtime for the rename.
